rationale: The customer reports a single back door sensor showing low battery and offline. This matches the BATTERY_LOW label: a battery camera/sensor offline or missing events, with live view failing to start. No other devices are reported offline, and the customer has not checked the rest of the system. The issue is isolated to one device with a clear low battery indication.

repair_steps: Replace the battery in the back door sensor with a fresh one of the correct type.
After replacing the battery, check the sensor's status in the app to see if it comes back online.
If the sensor does not come back online, try moving it closer to the base station temporarily to rule out signal issues.
If still offline, follow the app instructions to re-pair the sensor with the base station.
If the sensor remains offline after re-pairing, contact support for further assistance.
